{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
An '''aural flap''' was a part of an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian's]] anatomy. After the metamorphosis, Ithorians lost an aural flap.<ref name="MOAI">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/sourcearchive/news20070612.html|text=Musings of an Ithorian}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Aural flaps were first mentioned in ''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]'', a book published in [[1993]].<ref name="MAGL">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref> [[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], has indicated that information contained in the book is [[Canon|non-canonical]].<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=And is information from Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas canon? Unless referred to by a source that is in-continuity, the information is non-continuity.}}</ref> It was later made canonical with the publishing of ''[[Musings of an Ithorian]]'' on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]].
